_README: The Women in Power community roll, rendered by /about/.
This file is the ONLY place names live. Never write them into the HTML —
the page builds itself from here, so adding 900 people is a data edit and
nothing else. It can be exported straight from the attendance tracker.
name    required. As the person wants it shown.
roles   optional. Any of: mentor, mentee. Both is fine.
Sorting and de-duplication happen at render time, so order here does not
matter. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
CONSENT: only add someone who is happy to be listed publicly. The final
feedback form is the natural place to ask. When in doubt, leave them out —
a missing name is a smaller problem than an unwanted one.
